orespawn_integrations.freguesia.jade.key: To be a Parish: a signer's boss, 450 standing, or a Parish Show prize.
To be a Parish: a signer's boss, or 450 standing.
To be a Town: a signer who's a Knight, or 900 standing.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.key_miss: The Odete came by, looked and wrote it down: the key's missing.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.fir: A stray turned up at %s's place and stayed.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.ham: Two neighbours moved into %s's place. Nobody asked.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.par: %s's place is a Parish. The Odete brought a chair.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.tow: %s's place is a Town. The bell rings at noon, whether you like it or not.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.mutirao: Work party! Many hands (and a barbecue after).
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.stone_fe: The Parish Stone fell. The parish waits: set another within 30 days.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.signed_o: Signed. The Land has another name to gossip about.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.signers_: Four signatures already. The Odete has no more lines on the form.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.as: Signature requested. Someone who has signed must recognise it.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.si: Signature recognised by a signer. Signed on the Stone.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.la: Nobody recognised the signature. Scrap returned.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.fu: Four signatures already. The Stone is full.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.no: Only the Stone's signers can change it.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.marco.st: Four stakes, four corners. This isn't a plot yet.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.paris: Your Parish Stone reached its first stage, and a Caramelo moved in.
Two villagers walked in to take your spare beds.
Your stone became a Freguesia: the Land counts you now.
Your Freguesia became a Town, and its bell rings at noon.
Decorate a Parish Stone's ground with a friend at the same time.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.peddler: Wednesday is market day. A peddler's here.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.peddler_: Wednesday is market day. The market came to see the baby.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.mar: The market came to %s's place. Word is it was the craftsmanship.
orespawn_integrations.freguesia.deed.new: The market went to meet the new baby: %s.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.wonde: The market came to your house because it's the nicest one around.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.yard.opener: The casket was up to something, but this is somebody's yard.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.yard.opener_: The Land paid the yard's keeper.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.yard.deed: Somebody's casket turned into an ipê in %s's yard.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.bich: Something fell out of the branches. It isn't from here. It has a tag.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.desg: One more from the batch. This one fell far.

event.orespawn_integrations.hoard_fall.w: Something gold is falling. It isn't a star. Stars don't whistle.
event.orespawn_integrations.hoard_fall.f: Something gold fell while you slept. The smoke's still rising.
event.orespawn_integrations.hoard_fall.n: ROYAL TREASURY OF UTOPIA. Notice of loss, copy 94.
The vault cracked the night of the Spill and its contents have been falling ever since.
To whoever finds this: the items belong to the Crown, and the Crown is asleep,
so finders keepers until further notice.
The crack has not closed. More is coming. Please do not complain to the sky.
event.orespawn_integrations.hoard_fall.h: Gold fell %s of %s last night. Finders keepers until further notice.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.wonde: Open what the gold star cracked open when it whistled down: junk from ninety-four worlds.
